description: Stateless zero-persistence home-mls-ds relay (3A) forwarding client-signed RFC 9421 Space read requests (listWriters, getSpace, listRecords, getRecord, listRepoOps, getLatestCommit, getRepo, getBlob) to a remote Space host or writer PDS, returning raw bytes and preserving Atproto-Space-Commit / Atproto-Space-Record / Signature-Input / Signature headers.

targetDid.description: DID whose #atproto_pds or #atproto_mls endpoint serves the requested com.atproto.space.* read endpoint.

nsid.description: Read-only com.atproto.space.* NSID (listWriters, getSpace, listRecords, getRecord, listRepoOps, getLatestCommit, getRepo, getBlob).

query.description: Raw URL-encoded query string without leading '?'.

credential.description: Space credential JWT forwarded in Authorization / Atproto-Space-Credential.

signature.description: RFC 9421 Signature header produced by the client's ephemeral PoP key.

acceptSignature.description: Optional RFC 9421 Accept-Signature header requesting Atproto-Space-Commit or Atproto-Space-Record MAC authentication (#atproto_kem did:key share in keyid).

errors.name: AccountTakedown
errors.description: The operator has taken this account down. Only deleting the account's own data is still allowed.
